name: IID

args.name: n
args.description: Number of draws, a nonnegative integer

title: The Independent and Identically Distributed (i.i.d.) distribution
examples: ~IID(10, Normal(0,1))  # A list of 10 independent Normal(0,1) draws
description: IID produces a list of n independent draws from the same distribution dist. If dist has shared random parameters, the draws are independent conditional on those parameters.
